item.title: Pretty pool! Over one acre in Tennessee. $399,000
item.description: This house has a pretty pool! The house was built in 1900 It is located on 1.45 acres in Fayetteville, Tennessee. The house features a pretty staircase, french doors, some wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding, transom windows and built-ins. The house could use some undoing of past renovations. There is a large in-ground pool and outbuildings. item.description: This house has nice acreage with it and nice potential! The house was built in 1932. It is located on 21.7 acres in Atlanta, Texas. item.title: Furnished restaurant and apartment! Circa 1850 in Vermont. $285,000
item.description: This would be fun to own. It’s a restaurant on the lower level and an apartment above. It is being sold furnished and there is a commercial kitchen. It was built in 1850. It is located in Wardsboro, Vermont. The house features double front porches, updated apartment, some wood floors, baseboards, built-ins, bar area and a commercial kitchen. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,096 square feet. $285,000 Contact Jessica Samples with BHG Masiello Keene: 603-352-5433 From the Zillow listing: Opportu

item.title: Idaho’s most expensive old house listing! Eclectic interior! $5,495,000
item.description: Welcome to Idaho’s most expensive old house listing! The interior is eclectic! The house is bigger than it looks with over 4,000 square feet. The house was built in 1944. It is located in Ketchum, Idaho. The house features mature gardens, hot tub, fully finished basement, wrap around deck and views of Bald Mountain. Three bedrooms, four bathrooms and 4,124 square feet. $5,495,000 From the Zillow listing: Welcome to a truly extraordinary offering in the heart of Ketchum — a 4,474 SF legacy proper

item.title: Take a look inside! Beautiful views! Almost two acres in North Carolina. $400,000
item.description: Beautiful views from this North Carolina mountain house! I am loving the rustic interior! The house was built in 1930. It is located on 1.68 acres in Clyde, North Carolina. The furnishings are negotiable. The house features a covered porch, wood floors, vaulted ceiling, exposed beams, great windows, wood stove, loft area with two beds and a claw foot tub. Outdoors you will find a large deck and a gazebo with swing. One bedroom, one bathroom and 1,096 square feet. $400,000 Contact Matt Tavener wi

item.description: This house has a lot of potential! I love that it has two staircases and some acreage! Looks livable, so one could easily move in and work room by room. The house was built in 1830. It is located on 7.55 acres in Chase City, Virginia. The house could use some undoing of past renovations, but the areas that are original are nice. item.title: Pretty church with a pretty view! Circa 1934 in West Virginia.$149,900
item.description: This is a pretty church with an even prettier view! The church was built in 1934. It is located on .3 acre in Glen Falls, West Virginia. The church features wood floors, pretty ceiling, original pews, beautiful arched windows, crown moulding, baseboards and a spacious kitchen. The church is situated across from the Kanawha Falls section of the Kanawha River. There is potential for five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,316 square feet. $149,900 Contact Brian Mink with Bass Sinko Real Estate: 304-553

item.title: Original details! Could be so amazing! One acre in Wisconsin. $314,900
item.description: This house has so many original details! With some work, this could be really amazing. The house was built in 1873. It is located on one acre in Oshkosh, Wisconsin. The house features a spacious kitchen, wood floors, baseboards, pocket doors, crown moulding, two staircases, vintage light fixtures, ceiling medallions, floor to ceiling windows and original mantels. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,580 square feet. $314,900 Contact Jaimee A. Radloff with Roots Real Estate: Jaimee@rootsrealesta
